entries.title: I Corinthians 3:1
segments: And I, brothers, could not speak to you as to spiritual ones, but as to carnal, as to babes in Christ.

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:2
segments: I have fed you with milk and not with solid food, for you were not yet able [to bear it]; nor are you able even now.

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:3
segments: For you are yet carnal. For in that [there is] among you envyings and strife and divisions, are you not carnal, and [do you not] walk according to men?

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:4
segments: For while one says, I am of Paul; and another, I [am] of Apollos; are you not carnal?

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:5
segments: Who then is Paul, and who [is] Apollos, but ministers by whom you believed, even to each the Lord gave?

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:6
segments: I have planted, Apollos watered, but God gave the increase.

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:7
segments: So then neither is he who plants anything, nor he who waters, but God who gives the increase.

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:8
segments: So he planting, and he watering, are one, and each one shall receive [his] own reward according to [his] own labor.

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:9
segments: For we are fellow-workers of God, a field of God, and you are a building of God.

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:10
segments: According to the grace of God which is given to me, as a wise master builder, I have laid the foundation, and another builds [on it]. But let every man be careful how he builds [on it].

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:11
segments: For any other foundation can no one lay than that which is laid, which is Jesus Christ.

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:12
segments: And if anyone builds on this foundation gold, silver, precious stones, wood, hay, stubble,

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:13
segments: each one's work shall be revealed. For the Day shall declare [it], because it shall be revealed by fire; and the fire shall try each one's work as to what kind it is.

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:14
segments: If anyone's work which he built remains, he shall receive a reward.

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:15
segments: If anyone's work shall be burned up, he shall suffer loss. But he shall be saved, yet so as by fire.

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:16
segments: Do you not know that you are a temple of God, and [that] the Spirit of God dwells in you?

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:17
segments: If anyone defiles the temple of God, God shall destroy him. For the temple of God is holy, which you are.

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:18
segments: Let no one deceive himself. If anyone among you seems to be wise in this world, let him become a fool so that he may be wise.

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:19
segments: For the wisdom of this world is foolishness with God; for it is written, "He takes the wise in their own craftiness."

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:20
segments: And again, "[The] Lord knows the thoughts of the wise, that they are vain."

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:21
segments: Therefore let no one glory in men. For all things are yours,

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:22
segments: whether it is Paul, or Apollos, or Cephas, or [the] world, or life, or death, or things present, or things to come; all are yours,

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:23
segments: and you are Christ's, and Christ [is] God's.
